name: Soujin Shikou
source: [url=/c219]Karin's[/url] cousin and [url=/c59792]Ruurin's[/url] older sister. A honest girl with a carefree attitude but not very bright, sometimes even rivalizing with [url=/c19323]Shunran[/url] in the "Airhead" category. Admires Karin and wants to be helpful to her. Likes to undress to get more confortable for any reason and a fan of sleeping on roofs, sometimes even sleeping naked around different buildings' roofs.
